title: Can Chess Be Solved?
post: Can a computer ever solve chess? More possible games than atoms in the universe, a 549-move checkmate and a supercomputer with 140 TB. #chess #chesstok #math #science #computers

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: In 1950, Claude Shannon worked out how long a computer would need to calculate its first move.
phrases.say: [curious] In 1950, Claude Shannon worked out how long a computer would need... to calculate its FIRST move.
[deadpan] A one with ninety zeros. In years.

phrases.text: Because chess has more possible games than there are atoms in the universe. Way more.
phrases.say: Because chess has more possible games than there are atoms in the universe. [whispers] Way more.

phrases.text: Solving chess means knowing the result of perfect play from move one.
phrases.say: Solving chess means knowing the result of perfect play, from move one.

phrases.text: Checkers? Solved in 2007. Dozens of computers, eighteen years. The answer? A draw.
phrases.say: [impressed] Checkers? Solved in 2007. Dozens of computers, eighteen years... the answer? A draw.

phrases.text: Chess is way bigger. Just the legal positions make a number with 45 digits.
phrases.say: Chess is way bigger. Just the legal positions make a number with forty-five digits.

phrases.text: So far, we have solved every position with seven pieces or less. It took a supercomputer and 140 terabytes.
phrases.say: [serious] So far, we have solved every position with seven pieces or less. It took a supercomputer... and a hundred forty terabytes.

phrases.text: And it found a checkmate that takes 549 moves.
phrases.say: [amazed] And it found a checkmate... that takes five hundred forty-nine moves.
All thirty-two? With today's computers... [deadpan] impossible.

phrases.text: The best engines mostly draw each other. So perfect chess is probably a draw. But nobody can prove it.
phrases.say: The best engines mostly draw each other. So perfect chess is probably a draw... [whispers] but nobody can prove it.

phrases.text: Follow for more chess you didn't know.
phrases.say: Follow for more chess you didn't know.
